location_exception_reason: Telecom shelters are standardised, nationally-supplied infrastructure products governed by TEC Generic Requirements (TEC-GR-RS-BSH). Buyer decision is driven by technical specs (PUF thickness, IP rating, wind resistance, TEC approval), not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in telecom shelter titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Telecom Shelter Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product description; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
